spanish: Y cautivaron hijos de Israel a mujeres de Midyán y a su niño, y a toda su bestia y a todo su ganado y a toda su fuerza saquearon.

findings.issue: טַפָּם is masculine singular with a 3mp suffix and licenses their little ones as a collective; «niño» narrows that to one male child.
חֵילָם leaves strength, force, and substance open; «fuerza» selects strength.

notes: Both verbs, the other את objects, and each כָּל match the tokens.
